scripts.deploy:
echo '
  ✋ No Cloudflare deploy. The backend runs on TrueNAS (the box at marketscope.ludikure.org).
  `wrangler deploy` would resurrect the dead Cloudflare Worker (cron + KV) — that caused the
  2026-06-27 KV-limit incident. To ship worker changes: npm run build:server, then rebuild the
  TrueNAS container (docker compose up -d --build). See CLAUDE.md.
' && exit 1
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --external:undici --external:node-cron --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';import{fileURLToPath as __fu}from'url';import{dirname as __dn}from'path';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__fu(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__dn(__filename);" --outfile=dist/server.mjs
